overview: The School Committee reviewed a mid-year update on the district's strategic plan and the proposed scope for a multi-month equity audit. The committee also passed significant resolutions regarding summer school fee waivers for vulnerable students, the expansion of mental health support reporting, and the formal initiation of the state grant application process for Medford High School renovations.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and the minutes from the regular meeting held on January 10, 2022.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on community health resources, vaccination clinics, and the upcoming opening of the state school building grant application window.

items.title: Introduction to the Equity Process
items.summary: Cindy Weeks Bradley presented the framework for the district’s equity audit, which will initially focus on auditing human resources policies and recruitment strategies through May 2022.

items.title: COVID-19 Update
items.summary: District leadership outlined a shift toward utilizing state-provided rapid at-home testing kits for students and staff while phasing out traditional contact tracing for most populations.

items.title: Mid-Year Update on Strategic Plan
items.summary: The Superintendent reviewed progress on student achievement metrics, teacher diversification grants, and social-emotional safety programs implemented during the first half of the school year.

items.title: Camp Mustang Enrichment Program Overview
items.summary: Staff presented the "Camp Mustang 2.0" program, which will provide free academic and physical enrichment activities for students during the February and April vacation weeks.

items.title: Budget and FY23 Process Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed the second-quarter financial report and discussed a more efficient deliberation process for the FY23 budget focused on member-defined strategic priorities.

items.title: Summer School Fee Analysis
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy presented data on summer school fee collection and the demographic breakdown of students enrolled in credit recovery programs.

items.title: MSBA Application Deadline Update
items.summary: Administrators reported on the upcoming application windows for the Massachusetts School Building Authority Core and Accelerated Repair programs.

items.title: Resolution on Summer School Fee Waivers
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to waive summer credit recovery fees for economically disadvantaged students, English learners, and students with disabilities starting in June 2022.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan
items.summary: Referred the district's bullying prevention plan to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee for review and recommended updates.

items.title: Policy BEDB: Agenda Format
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the agenda creation policy to implement a numbering system for tracking motions and resolutions submitted by members.

items.title: Policy BEDEB: Public Participation
items.summary: Approved an amended policy that forwards community emails to the full committee while eliminating the requirement to read them aloud during meetings.

items.title: School Committee Rules of Order
items.summary: Referred a proposed draft of formal committee operating rules to a Committee of the Whole meeting scheduled for February 3.

items.title: Policy BEDC: Quorum Repeal
items.summary: Voted to repeal an antiquated policy regarding meeting quorums that was inconsistent with current state open meeting laws.

items.title: Policy BDT: School Attorney
items.summary: Referred the school attorney policy to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee to align the language with modern municipal standards.

items.title: Resolution on Mental Health Support Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the administration to provide a comprehensive report on district-wide mental health staffing and student support resources by mid-March.

items.title: Resolution on Medford High School Flagship Committee
items.summary: Approved a resolution to establish a stakeholder committee by April 2022 to define the educational vision for a new or renovated Medford High School.
